about_the_game:
Overview

Sometimes, grown-ups just need to be silly again.
In Bucket Tag: Construction Chaos, a bunch of overworked adults decide to blow off steam by playing their own ridiculous version of hide-and-seek — using whatever they can find: a bucket for a helmet, a broom for a weapon, and an air compressor for a pistol.

One player becomes the Seeker, blind to the world and guided only by sound, while the rest run, hide, slap, and shove their way through ten minutes of pure chaos.
It’s the ultimate stress relief — a playful return to childhood in the middle of absolute mayhem.

Key Features

  • 🎧 Sound-Based Gameplay – The Seeker plays completely blind, hunting only by hearing footsteps, crashes, and laughter.

  • 🪣 Inclusive by Design – One of the few games where blind and sighted players can compete together. The Seeker’s role is fully accessible and immersive for visually impaired players.

  • 🧍‍♂️ 7 Survivors vs. 1 Seeker – Up to 8 players in a hilarious game of hide-and-seek gone wrong.

  • 🖐️ Slap, Push & Prank – Hit your teammates to make noise, shove them into danger, or lure the Seeker closer just for laughs.

  • 🧱 Interactive Playground – A world of movable props, toppling barrels, and worker-grade chaos.

  • 😂 Stress-Relieving Mayhem – A goofy, physics-driven playground where acting silly is the whole point.

The Goal

The goal? Laugh harder, play louder, survive longer.

Simple as that.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti, AMD Radeon R7 260X, or Intel HD Graphics 530
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party game of hide-and-seek where a group of silly workers let loose and play with buckets, brooms, and air compressors. One blindfolded player hunts by sound alone in this hilarious, stress-relieving experience that’s also fully playable by blind and sighted players alike.
